title: Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Elopura Marathon Sandakan review: a record 3,000 runners in 2025, a 2am start from Sandakan Sports Complex, a heritage route and a children's charity.
dek: Sandakan's marathon drew a record 3,000 runners in 2025, raising support for children's palliative care. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan is a friendly, charitable town marathon on Sabah's east coast. The 2025 edition drew a record 3,000 runners from Malaysia and abroad over the marathon, half marathon and 10 km [1]. The first flag-off was at 2am from the Sandakan Sports Complex, and the routes passed St Michael's Church, the Sandakan Heritage Trail and the JCI Clock Tower [1]. It is part of the Sabah Marathon Series, alongside the Borneo International Marathon and the Tawau Marathon [1]. If you want a smaller marathon in Sabah with a heritage route and a good cause, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The race drew a record 3,000 runners, the largest turnout in its history [1]. There were three categories: the full marathon, half marathon and 10 km, with the earliest flag-off at 2am from the Sandakan Sports Complex [1].
It was organised by the Sandakan orthopaedic association, Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, with the Kinabalu Running Club, and more than 200 volunteers helped run it [1].

sections.heading: A Heritage Route and a Cause
paragraphs: The routes passed some of Sandakan's culturally significant landmarks, including St Michael's Church, the Sandakan Heritage Trail and the JCI Clock Tower [1].

The 2025 race supported the Malaysian Association of Paediatric Palliative Care, which is working towards Sabah's first children's hospice [1]. Race director Dr Timothy Cheng called it the biggest and most meaningful edition yet [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want to combine a marathon with a trip to Sandakan, or to complete the Sabah Marathon Series with the Borneo International Marathon and Tawau.
Plan for the 2am start: sleep early, and arrange transport to the sports complex in the middle of the night.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Elopura Marathon Sandakan in 2025?
faqs.answer: A record 3,000 runners from Malaysia and abroad took part in the 2025 edition, over the full marathon, half marathon and 10 km. It was the largest turnout in the race's history.

faqs.question: What time does the Elopura Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Very early. In 2025 the earliest flag-off was at 2am from the Sandakan Sports Complex. The routes then passed St Michael's Church, the Sandakan Heritage Trail and the JCI Clock Tower.

faqs.question: Is the Elopura Marathon part of a series?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is part of the Sabah Marathon Series, with the Borneo International Marathon in Kota Kinabalu and the Tawau Marathon. It is organised by Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan with the Kinabalu Running Club.
